title: English: PE Week & Past Tense 🏀
summary:
1. Play, Go, and Do (Sports)
• Use Play for ball sports (basketball, tennis, volleyball, football).
• Use Go for activities ending in -ing (running, swimming, climbing).
• Use Do for exercises or martial arts (karate, yoga).

2. Past Tense (Yesterday / Last Week)
When we talk about the past, verbs change!
• Go ➔ Went (I went swimming)
• Do ➔ Did (I did yoga)
• Play ➔ Played (I played tennis)

3. Regular Past Tense Spelling Rules
• Add +ed: jump ➔ jumped.
• Add +d (if it ends in 'e'): dance ➔ danced.
• Drop 'y' and add +ied: carry ➔ carried.

4. Making Negative (-) and Questions (?)
• Negative: Use didn't + Base Verb (I didn't play football.)
• Question: Use Did + Subject + Base Verb (Did you go running?)

5. With vs For
• Use with for people (with my brother).
• Use for for time (for one hour).

questions.questionText: Match the sports to the correct verbs (Present Tense)!
questions.hint: Play is for balls. Go is for '-ing'. Do is for exercise.

questions.questionText: Match the Present Tense words to their Past Tense words!
questions.hint: How do we say these words when they happened yesterday?

questions.questionText: During PE week, we ______ basketball in the gym.
questions.hint: Basketball uses a ball, so we use the past tense of 'play'.

questions.questionText: On Tuesday, my sister ______ swimming at the pool.
questions.hint: Swimming ends in '-ing', so we use the past tense of 'go'.

questions.questionText: Yesterday, the children ______ karate.
questions.hint: Karate is a martial art, so we use the past tense of 'do'.

questions.questionText: Write the correct past tense word in the blank space: We _______ volleyball on the beach. (play)
questions.hint: Add +ed to 'play'.

questions.questionText: Write the correct past tense word in the blank space: I _______ climbing yesterday. (go)
questions.hint: The past tense of 'go' is completely different! It starts with 'w'.

questions.questionText: Write the correct past tense word in the blank space: She _______ yoga in the morning. (do)
questions.hint: The past tense of 'do' is a short word starting with 'd'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling rule: Last week, I (walk) ______ to the park.
questions.hint: For most words, we just add +ed.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling rule: We (dance) ______ at the party.
questions.hint: If the word already ends in 'e', just add +d.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling rule: The baby (cry) ______ last night.
questions.hint: Drop the 'y' and add +ied.

questions.questionText: Negative Past Tense: I played tennis. ➔ I ______ tennis.
questions.hint: After 'didn't', the verb goes back to its normal shape (base verb).

questions.questionText: Negative Past Tense: She went running. ➔ She didn't ______ running.
questions.hint: After 'didn't', 'went' turns back into its normal shape.

questions.questionText: Make a question using 'Did': You played football. ➔ ______ you play football?
questions.hint: To ask a past tense question, start with this 3-letter word.

questions.questionText: Make a question: ______ he do karate yesterday?
questions.hint: Yesterday is in the past, so we use the past tense question word.

questions.questionText: Choose 'with' or 'for': I played tennis ______ my best friend.
questions.hint: Use this word when doing something together with a person.

questions.questionText: Choose 'with' or 'for': I went swimming ______ two hours.
questions.hint: Use this word to talk about how much time has passed.

questions.questionText: Tick ALL the sentences that are CORRECT in the Past Tense!
questions.hint: One sentence is wrong! Remember, after 'didn't', no +ed!

questions.questionText:
Write a sentence about what you did in PE week!
(Example: I played football with my friends.)
questions.hint: Start with 'I', then use 'played', 'went', or 'did'.
